ideas.pitch: A multilingual voice-first rural health screening and early outbreak detection system tailored for India's semi-urban populations.
ideas.problem_statement: Healthcare accessibility and preventative education in rural or semi-urban regions across India.
ideas.title: ArogyaVani
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages a proven winning pattern from SAGACITY with a localized voice interface, addressing India's pressing healthcare accessibility challenges directly within an open innovation framework.

ideas.pitch: AI-powered satellite imagery and compliance monitoring for industrial estates to track environmental violations and waste management.
ideas.problem_statement: Sustainability and environmental compliance tracking for growing industrial sectors across Indian states.
ideas.title: EcoAudit India
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the concrete geospatial monitoring approach of GeoNex-ATLAS to target open sustainability tracks, providing judges with a high-impact visual utility.

ideas.pitch: Personalized multi-agent AI student support platform combining regional curriculum RAG and adaptive remediation paths.
ideas.problem_statement: Education and learning outcome disparities in diverse Indian academic environments.
ideas.title: ShikshaGraph
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly applies the multi-agent student support architecture proven in greennovation-ai-platform, offering a robust technical implementation for education.

ideas.pitch: Graph intelligence and risk detection platform tailored for detecting suspicious micro-transactions and digital fraud in emerging FinTech.
ideas.problem_statement: FinTech security and automated Anti-Money Laundering (AML) risk mitigation for peer-to-peer and digital payment systems.
ideas.title: FinShield AML India
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the hard engineering and graph intelligence demonstrated by Bito, giving judges an enterprise-grade financial security tool to evaluate.

ideas.pitch: Autonomous data quality and incident response pipeline that automatically repairs schema anomalies and logs write-backs.
ideas.problem_statement: Data engineering reliability and automated error remediation for data-driven enterprises and startups.
ideas.title: DataPulse AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs the autonomous incident response pattern of BlackBox DataHub, showcasing complex autonomous agent workflows that stand out in open innovation hackathons.
